# OmsiHook Upstream

Status: NORMATIVE PROVENANCE

OmsiLaunch uses the read-only upstream checkout at:

`third_party/upstream/Omsi-Extensions/`

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Upstream repository | `https://github.com/space928/Omsi-Extensions` |
| Pinned commit | `7687b6623f5f74b4419695257bd2a4eef54dd93e` |
| Retrieved | 2026-09-07 |
| Upstream license | LGPL-3.0-only |
| Role | Reference and selectively adapted ancestor |

OmsiLaunch is not a fork of Omsi-Extensions and does not expose OmsiHook's RPC
protocol as its product protocol. Adapted code carries a source-level provenance
header and is listed in `OMSIHOOK-REUSE-MATRIX.md`.

The pinned checkout must not be edited to accommodate OmsiLaunch builds.
